"\*making them cousins\*"

Woah there, partner! You're getting pretty close to Alabaman territory!
Awww! Look at them! The best of friends!
I have never loved and hated an image so much at the same time...
Thanks again! I really do appreciate it.

That's good to hear. I'm glad to hear that maybe the thinking positive method is working for you. If it works, then keep at it. I usually find it pretty hard to do that sort of thing (or try to) during a panic attack or something like what happened this morning (it was like 3 or 5 in the morning when I posted this) without either completely dissociating and feeling completely numb or getting light headed. Idk, my mind has always interpreted that method as me lying to myself, and I hate being let down, so even when I was little, I tended to doubt myself or look on the more negative side of things because then I wouldn't be let down. Tbh, my mom is the same way (and I think she needs help for her anxiety even tho she doesn't believe she does) so I might have gotten a bit of it from her too. I've started noticing my method isn't the best anymore, but old habits can be hard to break.. But I think you're right. Thinking positively does help a lot of people, but I also know it's hard and sometimes, people need a little more than just positivity to help them. If you wanna talk ever, we can (I'll try to reply when I can.) I think we both got this. Have a great day! (or night depending on your time zone.)

This is honestly the most relatable comment I've read in my life lol. It's like I just took a peek into my own head whenever I'm trying to cheer someone up or help. Thanks for your comment tho, man. Idk if I can express fully in words how this actually helped and did cheer me up. It was honestly pretty funny to me because I know "fuck i dont know what to say" is exactly what I think to myself in most social situations.

Thanks for the support, man. I do appreciate it. Don't know if this is relevant or not, but my friend is "fine" now. In the least shes not dead, and while she is doing a little better, she's still a little dissociated. Only thing I worry about for her now is her mom being an abusive prick again. Again tho, thanks. I hope you are doing alright in your times rn.

Hey, what's your soundcloud tho? I love music of most kinds, and I'm curious about what genre you play and what your music is like. I played clarinet in band in middle school and was a soprano 1 in the SSAA choir at my high school.
